good-shepherd-01.title: Calling the flock

good-shepherd-01.caption: A shepherd turns toward the sheep at the open fold. His attentive call pictures the familiar voice and personal care Jesus describes in His teaching.

good-shepherd-03.caption: The hired worker runs as danger approaches, leaving the sheep behind. Jesus contrasts this flight with the care of the good shepherd.
